ModuleTitle.helper: Used by OpenContent and DNN module settings. This is not displayed to site visitors.

ModuleAnchor.helper: Optional. Creates a page anchor for direct links to this section. Use only letters, numbers, and hyphens.

SectionTitle.helper: Optional. The main heading displayed above the cards. HTML is allowed and will render as entered.

SectionDescription.helper: Required. Introduce this group of cards in one or two short sentences. HTML is allowed and will render as entered.
SectionDescription.placeholder: Explain the shared benefit these cards help visitors understand.

Cards.label: Cards
Cards.helper: Add as many cards as needed. Only the first three cards are displayed on the website.

Title.helper: Required. Add a short, clear heading for this card. HTML is allowed and will render as entered.
Title.placeholder: Help customers find the right choice

Description.helper: Required. Briefly explain this benefit. HTML is allowed and will render as entered.
Description.placeholder: Organize your offerings so customers can quickly find what they need.

Icon.helper: Required. Find icons at FontAwesome. Example: fas fa-building

IconColor.helper: Choose a strong icon color. Its background uses a lighter transparent version of the same color. Default uses the current theme text color.

CardLink.helper: Optional. Select a local page or enter a complete http or https URL. When provided, the whole card becomes a link and displays Learn More.

SectionFooter.helper: Optional. Add a short note below the cards. HTML is allowed and will render as entered.
SectionFooter.placeholder: Choose a benefit to learn more.
